Least count corresponding to the main scale and circular scale of a screw

gauge are 0.5 mm and 0.005 mm, respectively. A wire of diameter 2.675 mm

is measured with the screw gauge. What would be the reading of divisions

on circular scale of the screw gauge, if the zero error of the screw gauge is

+0.02 mm ?

Options :

6760333241. 31

6760333242. 35

6760333243. 39

6760333244. 61

independent_expected_oracle.basis: Observed reading = true diameter + positive zero error = 2.675 mm + 0.020 mm; main-scale contribution 2.5 mm; (2.695 - 2.5)/0.005 = 39. Independent calculation, not native answer.
